title: Polynomial-time unary encoding of a width bound
statement: Let $A,a\in\mathbb N$. The function sending a bit string $y$ to a unary string of length $A(|x|+1)^a$, where $x$ is the decoded first component of $y$ and is empty if decoding fails, is polynomial-time computable.
